run_linear_evaluation: run DINOv2 linear evaluation on ImageNet with frozen features and grid search learning rates
create_linear_classifier: create a LinearClassifier module with a single linear layer on top of frozen DINOv2 features
setup_linear_classifiers: setup multiple LinearClassifiers with different block counts, avgpool options, and learning rates for grid search
evaluate_linear_classifiers: evaluate all linear classifiers on a validation dataset and log top-1 accuracy metrics
test_on_datasets: test the best linear classifier from validation on multiple external test datasets with class mappings
